machine.description: PTV 'New Line' (NL) gantry water jet cutting table, 3000 x 2000 mm working area, one Z axis (1Z) carrying a ProgressJet 5-axis dynamic cutting head (PJ, axes A1/B1), abrasive feeder on Z1 and optional height-control sensor.
machine.manufacturer: PTV, spol. s r.o., Csl. armady 23, 253 01 Hostivice, Czech Republic, tel. +420 220 981 430
machine.distributor_owner: A. Moreira Cadete, Lda. (AMC), Portugal - authorised PTV distributor; the drawings carry its title block and the electrical documentation is addressed 'CADETE - P'
machine.electrical_documentation: PTV-V52-N-0001 (file PTV-052-N-0001 (UD) EN), 126 sheets, completed 08.10.2008, last update 06.11.2012, editor Fedyszyn Milan
machine.control_system: AREM PRO Cnc886 running on an Advantech IPC 6606 CZ industrial PC (Windows 10 IoT Enterprise with IntervalZero RTX real-time extension). CAN bus 1 to the servo drives, CAN bus 2 to the Elsaco PROMOS line2 PLC I/O modules and the abrasive feeder, RS232/RS485 to the high-pressure pump, RS422 to the AHW886 hand wheel.
machine.high_pressure_pump: PTV JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT, 37 kW, 4100 bar (60 000 psi), 3.8 l/min, one H2O Jet 60K intensifier (manual M-01/2007-EN)

variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.20: Abrasive feeder Z1 (Berger Lahr IFA61 CAN stepper, sheets 49-50)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.30: Remote control hand wheel AHW886 via RS422 converter SLC31 (sheets 25-26)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.47: High-pressure pump PTV RS485 communication via SLC31 converter A43 (sheets 25, 42)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.51: Light barrier XUSLB/XUSLZ with XPS-AFL5130 safety module FB2 (sheet 24)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.65: Height control system Z1 (Festo SMAT-8E analogue sensor + valve YV14) (sheets 32, 36)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=OPT.70: Catcher water level control (valves YV7.1/YV7.2, selector SB8) (sheets 22, 34)
variant_options_installed_or_wired.=AXS.X1, Y1, Y2, Z1, A1, B1: Installed axes (X2, Z2, A2, B2, C2 appear in the generic PTV schematic as unused options)

location_codes.+MZ1: Wiring connection box Z axis trolley 1
location_codes.+MAB1: Wiring box dynamic water jet A1/B1

power_supply.recommended_protection: 25 A / B circuit breaker or PN 000 gG 25 A fuse
power_supply.control_voltage: 24 V DC from U2 DNR240PS24-I (10 A, 240 W)
power_supply.overvoltage_protection: Not included in the machine - 2nd degree surge protection must be provided by the installation
power_supply.servo_supply_breaker: QF1 PL7-C13/3 (13 A, 3-pole) with ZP-NHK auxiliary contact, feeding the drives through E-stop contactors KM1/KM2
power_supply.ups: U1 APC Back-UPS CS650 feeding the IPC
power_supply.environment: +5 to +30 C ambient, 30-90 % RH, max 1000 m altitude, dust < 20 mg/m3
power_supply.note: The high-pressure pump has its own 37 kW supply: CYKY 4x25/5x25 mm2 (up to 15 m) protected 100 A, or 4x35/5x35 mm2 protected 125 A; 80 A knife fuses inside the pump distributor; plus a 3x400 V 25 A and 230 V 25 A service socket per pump manual 1.2.2.

pump_specs_summary.hydraulic_oil: 160 l (170 l for change) SHELL TELLUS 46 / OHHM 46 / Chevron AW-46 / Exxon Nuto H-46 / Texaco Rando HD-46; max 52 C working, 215 bar max
pump_specs_summary.hydraulic_pump: Parker PV063 63 cm3/rev with proportional valve
pump_specs_summary.inlet_water: 3.5-6 bar, pH 6-8, filtered 1 um + 0.5 um cascade, G3/4 connections

safety_chain.emergency_stop_module: FB1 Telemecanique XPS-AC5121 (sheet 23) - monitors SB2 panel E-stop (XB5AS542 + ZBE102 double contact), the pump E-stop line via XT7 (sheet 42) and the hand wheel E-stop via XT5; contacts 13-14/23-24/33-34 drive KM1 and KM2
safety_chain.contactors: KM1 + KM2 LC1D18BD (24 V DC coils) in series switch the servo drive mains (sheet 15: L1.1/L2.1/L3.1 -> 2L1.1/2L2.1/2L3.1) and signal 'state of emergency stop safety module' to PLC DI 1.0
safety_chain.light_barrier: Optional FB2 XPS-AFL5130 with XUSLB transmitter / XUSLZ receiver and KM3/KM4 (sheets 23-24, 33)
safety_chain.drive_limit_switches: Every linear axis has P_STOP / N_STOP hardware limit switches (XCM N2103L1) wired to the SERVOSTAR X3 PSTOP/NSTOP inputs, plus an inductive reference switch wired to the drive (sheets 28, 35-40)
safety_chain.pump_total_stop: S1 mushroom button on the pump panel; machine SB4 PRESS PUMP START/STOP buttons act through the PLC and the pump I/O cable (sheet 42)
safety_chain.working_hours_counter: UX1 Bauser 609.2 (24 V DC) counts hours while the safety chain is closed
safety_chain.warning: Before any electrical work: switch QS1 off and lock it, bleed the high-pressure system to zero (pump 'STOP', button '0'), wait for the drive DC bus to discharge. Only qualified personnel may work on the 400 V and 600 V DC bus parts (manual pump 4.1, electrical tech report 11).
